title: Via run record (findings.json)
description: Written by Claude into the run folder, then merged by via_run.py. Claude never writes id, status or merged_at: via_run.py adds them. via_run.py is the source of truth for validation; this file documents the same rules.

scope.description: "all", or the screens this run covered. A finding is marked fixed only when its screen is in scope.

redacted.description: True when capture masked personal data in this shot.

review.description: Claude's verdict after looking at the shot. Only kept shots may leave the run folder (via_run.py outbound-shots).

platform.description: Set by native capture: flutter or compose.

state.description: Set by native capture, from the preview's name.

source.description: Native capture only: an app preview, or the screen on a running device or emulator (the fallback).

coverage.description: Set from native capture: what it shot and, for what it did not, why. Say the gaps in the summary.

kind.description: What entry names: a state (state:<name>), a matrix shot (phone-light, large-dark, font-largest, rtl), a skipped preview (preview:<function>) or a free note.

id.description: Set by via_run.py: VIA-<screen>-<8 hex>, with -2, -3 for same screen, rule and file.

rule.description: A short stable name for the kind of problem, such as contrast. Part of the ID.

source.description: The skill or second opinion that raised it. A second opinion is named second-opinion:<who>, for example second-opinion:claude.

verdict.description: Second-opinion verdict after checking against code and screenshots. Required when source starts with second-opinion, and a wrong one then becomes status dismissed: kept here as evidence, never added to the ledger. On any other source the verdict is informational.

route.description: Set after the batch approval: fix-now (small, local, low-risk), ticket (cross-screen or design-system) or reject. `via_run.py route` acts on it.

route_reason.description: One line on why this route. Required whenever route is set; on reject it becomes the rejection reason, on a ticket it fills the Why a ticket column.

group.description: Ticket route only: an optional theme for grouping, such as Buttons. Ticket findings without one are grouped by screen.

status.description: Set by via_run.py: new, open, rejected, or dismissed (a second-opinion finding with verdict wrong).

ticket.description: Set by via_run.py route: the markdown ticket path (or a Jira key). A finding with a ticket is never filed again.

prototype.description: Set by via_prototype.py build: where this finding sits on the prototype page. Anchors only; they also go into the ledger.

Set by via_prototype.py: the run's prototype page. `build` writes the local file; `link` adds the private Artifact URL when the project may publish to artifacts. The URL stays in this untracked record and never goes into the ledger.

reason.description: Why the page is local only, or what allowed publishing.

held.description: Set by via_run.py merge: ledger IDs that a finding judged wrong in this run stands for, each with the run that last saw it. `pass` leaves them out until a later run sees them again.

merged_at.description: Set by via_run.py merge. `pass` refuses a run without it.
